notes: Per user decision, this is ONE merged webinar-generation stage — confirmed against source: the ROLE section states the webinar's content is built by 'synthesising the strongest elements from competitor webinars,' and Steps 1-8 run linearly in a single prompt execution. The topic field is multi-select, so Step 2's competitor synthesis and Step 2B's set plan are produced once for the whole set and Steps 3-8 repeat per selected topic, one complete package each. The old DAG's separate 'competitor-sourced' and 'LLM-sourced' webinar stages are superseded by this single call.

fields.label: Webinar Topics / Working Titles
fields.raw_explanation: The topics the operator picked at the suggestion gate — a numbered list. The prompt builds one complete webinar package per topic (Step 2's competitor synthesis is shared across the set, Step 2B plans it, Steps 3-8 run per webinar), so this field is a programme rather than one title.

fields.label: Competitor Webinar Sources
fields.raw_explanation: UPLOAD OR PASTE — transcripts, slide content, or URLs of 2-5 competitor webinars. Step 2 (Competitor Webinar Synthesis) reads all sources supplied here.

fields.label: Compliance Sensitivity
fields.raw_explanation: Healthcare / Financial / Legal / Other regulated field: specify / None

fields.label: ICP Document
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1B: full avatar — demographics, psychographics, core pains and fears, goals, objections, decision criteria, awareness level, and exact language/phrases. "Use the ICP's exact language from earlier outputs in this conversation."

fields.label: Brand Voice / Proof Points (from CRO and Funnel)
fields.raw_explanation: Step 1A: brand voice and tone from approved pillar page and funnel copy; key proof points, stats, case studies, and testimonials approved for use; product/service differentiators already established.

fields.label: Design Tokens
fields.raw_explanation: Step 5 (Slide Deck Brief): "Reference the client's brand colours and design language from earlier outputs."

fields.label: Competitor Analysis — Webinars
fields.raw_explanation: Synthesized field — sourced from the paired Competitor Analysis — Webinars stage (08_Webinars.md), which identifies which competitors genuinely run self-hosted webinar programs worth sourcing transcripts/slides from for the Competitor Webinar Sources field above. Not explicitly named in this prompt's own text, which only asks for raw source uploads.
